name: raahat
description: RAAHAT — Regional AI for Accessibility, Assistance & Transport

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && (test -f .venv/bin/python && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload || python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload)
